pin_needed_to_receive.title: “I need my PIN to receive money”
pin_needed_to_receive.prompt: Ask: when someone sends you money, what do you have to do? Show a collect request on the board and circle the word “requesting”. Agree on the rule: a PIN is only ever for paying, never for receiving.

bank_will_call_for_otp.title: “The bank may ask for my OTP”
bank_will_call_for_otp.prompt: Read a fake KYC message aloud. Ask who really sent it and how they could tell. Agree: a bank never asks for an OTP, PIN or password by call, SMS or link.
bank_will_call_for_otp.activity: Scam Inbox: Your KYC Expires Today

guaranteed_returns_exist.title: “Some investments are guaranteed to double”
guaranteed_returns_exist.prompt: Sort three offers on the board into investing, gambling or scam. Ask what words made something feel safe. Agree: real investing never promises a fixed high return.

too_late_to_report.title: “It’s too late to report a scam”
too_late_to_report.prompt: Put the recovery steps in order together. Stress speed: call 1930 and the bank first, then report at cybercrime.gov.in.

bank_asks_otp.title: “A bank or support agent can ask for my OTP”
bank_asks_otp.prompt: Ask: what is an OTP for? Agree that it proves it is you, so nobody who asks for it can be on your side. Role-play a caller asking for it and practise saying no and hanging up.
bank_asks_otp.activity: The Call: Fake customer care, and Digital arrest

trust_sms_credit.title: “If an SMS says money arrived, it arrived”
trust_sms_credit.prompt: Show a fake credit alert next to a bank app screen with no credit. Ask which one shows the truth. Agree: check your own bank app, and never return money based on a message.

trust_familiar_name.title: “A familiar name means it is who I think”
trust_familiar_name.prompt: Ask how a message from Mom on a new number could be checked. Agree: call the number you already have before you send anything.
trust_familiar_name.activity: Scam Inbox and Red Flag Hunter

trust_familiar_account.title: “If a friend's chat asks, it is my friend”
trust_familiar_account.prompt: Ask how you would know if a friend's account was hacked. Practise a question only they could answer, then calling their saved number.

authority_demands_money.title: “Police or officials can ask me to move money”
authority_demands_money.prompt: Ask: can police arrest someone over a video call? Agree that no agency has a safe account and that hanging up and calling 1930 is always allowed.

search_result_is_official.title: “The first search result is the real helpline”
search_result_is_official.prompt: Search for a helpline together and point out the Ad label. Agree: use the Help section inside the official app.

loan_app_permissions.title: “A loan app needs my contacts and photos”
loan_app_permissions.prompt: List what a lender really needs and what a scam app asks for. Agree: deny permissions that have nothing to do with a loan, and report harassment on 1930.

fraud_recovery_mistake.title: “After a scam I should wait, or pay someone to recover it”
fraud_recovery_mistake.prompt: Put the recovery steps in order as a class: bank, 1930, evidence, then secure accounts. Ask why a recovery agent who wants a fee is a second scam.

scan_to_receive.title: “I scan a code to receive money”
scan_to_receive.prompt: Show a QR payment screen and ask which way the money goes. Agree: scanning a code starts a payment from you. To receive, share your own UPI ID.

pay_to_get_job.title: “A real job can ask me for a fee”
pay_to_get_job.prompt: Ask who pays whom in a real job. Agree that a registration or training fee for a job offer is a scam.

pay_to_win.title: “I can pay a fee to claim a prize”
pay_to_win.prompt: Ask if you can win a draw you never entered. Agree that a real prize never asks for money first.

click_unknown_link.title: “It is fine to tap a link in a message”
click_unknown_link.prompt: Show a short link and ask where it goes. Agree: open the official app instead of tapping links in messages.
click_unknown_link.activity: Scam Inbox and Red Flag Hunter

distrust_everything.title: “Every message is a scam”
distrust_everything.prompt: Sort real and fake messages together. Agree that being careful means checking, not blocking everyone, because real alerts and school messages matter.

pin_uncovered.title: “No one is watching when I type my PIN”
pin_uncovered.prompt: Ask where someone could see your PIN at a shop or ATM. Practise covering the keypad every time.
